name: hyprlock
summary: Fast, GPU-accelerated lock screen for Hyprland.
description: Hyprland's official lock screen. It uses the ext-session-lock protocol, renders on the GPU, can show a blurred screenshot of your desktop as the background, and supports fingerprint unlock through libfprint. Its look is set in a config file and can reuse Hyprland's gradient borders, blur, shadows and animations.
